subject.title: Support storing UI preferences in config.json/preferences.json for dotfiles syncing

question: Should CodexBar support a separate opt-in portable preferences.json for non-secret UI settings, and which UserDefaults keys are portable versus device-local?
rationale: This changes persisted data, sync/privacy behavior, and upgrade precedence; the closed owner prototype shows the storage contract is not safe enough without explicit maintainer direction.

options.title: Approve separate preferences.json
options.body: Define a sparse schema beside the resolved config path, preserve unknown fields or refuse unsafe writes, document precedence, and add tested SettingsStore wiring.

options.title: Keep UserDefaults-only settings
options.body: Defer dotfiles syncing for UI preferences unless maintainers prefer a manual export/import workflow instead of continuous sync.

options.title: Use a config.json preferences block
options.body: Allow a preferences block in the existing provider config only if maintainers intentionally accept the secret-sync affordance risk.

recommendation.title: Approve separate preferences.json
recommendation.body: Define a sparse schema beside the resolved config path, preserve unknown fields or refuse unsafe writes, document precedence, and add tested SettingsStore wiring.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the closed prototype and has the strongest settings/config history signal for the storage contract decision.
